facts.text: Serve Ness his drink when he first arrives in Chicago and meets Malone.
facts.why: Ness has already had a failed liquor raid before he 'soon encounters' Malone, so 'first arrives' is loose. The drink Ness has is at the very end ('I think I'll have a drink').
facts.fix: Serve the drinks when Ness first meets Malone after the failed raid.

facts.text: POUR THE DRINKS WHEN NESS FIRST MEETS MALONE WALKING HIS BEAT STOP
facts.why: Ness meeting Malone is right. No opened source says Malone is walking his beat at that moment.
facts.fix: POUR THE DRINKS WHEN NESS FIRST MEETS MALONE STOP

facts.why: The film is set in 1930 and has a banquet dinner where Capone uses the bat. No source I opened gives the date.

facts.text: Capone's own beer. Every bar in town has to stock it
facts.why: Capone supplying liquor and controlling Chicago is in the plot summary. Nothing opened mentions his own lager or bars forced to stock it.
facts.fix: Capone's supply. Down from the border by the truckload

vibe.verdict: A great Lexington banquet room that uses the bat dinner and Ness's last drink, but misses the station stairs.
missing: The baby carriage on the Union Station stairs (the shootout)
Here endeth the lesson (Ness, Capone's trial)
Capone's baseball bat banquet (the Lexington dinner)
Nitti thrown off the courthouse roof (finale)
ideas: Swap 'Cold tea, served in china cups' for a Malone line: 'Here endeth the lesson, and the tea.'
Swap 'Chicago deep dish' (unprinted) for a mother and pram plate for four, a stairs nod.
Replace 'Gratuities at the table' with 'Never stop fighting until the fight is done.'
